title: Confluence Subagent Response
description: The mandatory output contract for the Confluence subagent. Every response MUST be a valid JSON object matching this schema. No free-form text is permitted outside this structure.

status.description: Outcome of the operation. 'partial' means results were returned but some pages/spaces were inaccessible.

operation.description: The Confluence operation that was performed.

error.description: Present only when status is 'error'. Describes what went wrong.

remediation.description: Suggested action for the user or orchestrator to resolve the error.

summary.description: A concise natural-language summary of the results, suitable for display to the user. Required when status is 'success' or 'partial'.

pages.description: List of Confluence pages returned by the operation.

url.description: Full URL to the page in Confluence Cloud.

space_key.description: Key of the Confluence space the page belongs to.

space_name.description: Display name of the Confluence space.

author.description: Display name of the page author.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last page update.

version.description: Current version number of the page.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt or summary of the page content. Maximum 500 characters.

content.description: Full extracted text content of the page. Only populated for get_page operations.

spaces.description: List of Confluence spaces returned by a list_space operation.

url.description: Full URL to the space in Confluence Cloud.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata. Present when the operation returned paginated results.

total.description: Total number of matching results (across all pages).

returned.description: Number of results included in this response.

has_more.description: True if additional results exist beyond what was returned.

next_start.description: Start index to use for the next page of results.

examples.summary: Found 3 pages matching 'quarterly planning' in the Engineering space.

pages.title: Q3 2025 Engineering Planning
pages.author: Jane Smith
pages.excerpt: This page outlines the Q3 2025 engineering objectives and key results...

error.remediation: Check that ATLASSIAN_EMAIL and ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN are correct, then re-run bash scripts/validate.sh.
